_README: Copy this to declarations.json and replace every value. `mag audit --declarations declarations.json` checks that each key is present, non-empty, and not still a placeholder. It does not and will not supply them: these are facts about YOUR study, and a pipeline that filled them in would be inventing an ethics approval. Delete this _README key before use.
ethics_source_study: [the approval under which the ORIGINAL data were collected, with committee, reference number and date, exactly as the source publication states it — or the words NOT REPORTED if the source publication does not state one]
ethics_present_study: [the approval or documented waiver for THIS secondary analysis, with committee, reference and date — or a statement that your institution does not require review for analysis of this public archive, naming the policy]
consent_for_publication: [whether consent for publication was required and obtained, or why it does not apply]
funding: [funders and grant numbers, or the words: this research received no specific grant from any funding agency]
author_contributions: [CRediT roles per author: conceptualization, methodology, software, validation, formal analysis, investigation, data curation, writing - original draft, writing - review and editing, visualization, supervision, project administration, funding acquisition]
ai_use: [what AI assistance was used, for what, and who verified the output. Journals increasingly require this and it belongs in the paper whether or not the target journal asks]
repository_url: [the public URL of this repository at the commit that produced the results]
osf_registration: [the registration identifier and its URL, with the registration date, so a reader can check that the protocol predates the results]
code_archive_doi: [the Zenodo or equivalent DOI minted from a tagged release, which is what makes the code citable and immutable]
data_availability: [where the archive came from, under what licence, and what a reader must do to obtain it — plus a statement that no new data were generated by this analysis, if that is true]
